    function build(api) {

      const C_BLACK = 0x1a1a1a, C_SCREEN = 0x1e90ff, C_GRAY = 0x696969, C_SILVER = 0xc0c0c0, C_BLUE = 0x0080ff, C_RED = 0xff0000;
      
      api.group('body', '主体');
        api.pivot([0, 1.5, 0], 'scene'); // Not strictly needed but good for root

        api.box({w:5.2, h:2.4, d:0.05, pos:[0, 1.5, 0.22], color:C_SCREEN});
        api.group('stand', '支架');
          api.pivot([0, 0.5, -0.2], 'body');
          api.box({w:2.0, h:2.0, d:0.05, pos:[0, 1.5, -0.25], color:C_GRAY});

        api.box({w:1.5, h:0.1, d:0.2, pos:[0, 3.05, 0], color:C_BLACK}); // top slot

      api.endGroup();
      
      api.group('leftController', '左手柄');
        api.pivot([-3.0, 1.5, 0], 'body');
        api.box({w:1.0, h:3.0, d:0.6, pos:[-3.5, 1.5, 0.1], color:C_BLUE});
        api.box({w:0.1, h:2.8, d:0.5, pos:[-2.95, 1.5, 0.1], color:C_BLACK}); // rail
        api.cyl({r:0.25, h:0.2, along:'+Z', pos:[-3.5, 2.5, 0.4], color:C_BLACK}); // joystick base
        api.sphere({r:0.2, pos:[-3.5, 2.5, 0.55], color:0x333333}); // joystick cap

        api.box({w:0.3, h:0.1, d:0.05, pos:[-3.2, 2.0, 0.35], color:C_BLACK}); // minus
      api.endGroup();
      
      api.group('rightController', '右手柄');
        api.pivot([3.0, 1.5, 0], 'body');
        api.box({w:1.0, h:3.0, d:0.6, pos:[3.5, 1.5, 0.1], color:C_RED});
        api.box({w:0.1, h:2.8, d:0.5, pos:[2.95, 1.5, 0.1], color:C_BLACK}); // rail
        api.cyl({r:0.25, h:0.2, along:'+Z', pos:[3.5, 2.5, 0.4], color:C_BLACK}); // joystick base
        api.sphere({r:0.2, pos:[3.5, 2.5, 0.55], color:0x333333}); // joystick cap
        api.poly({r:0.12, pos:[3.5, 1.5, 0.4], color:C_BLACK}); // X
        api.poly({r:0.12, pos:[3.5, 0.9, 0.4], color:C_BLACK}); // B
        api.poly({r:0.12, pos:[3.2, 1.2, 0.4], color:C_BLACK}); // Y
        api.poly({r:0.12, pos:[3.8, 1.2, 0.4], color:C_BLACK}); // A
        api.box({w:0.8, h:0.3, d:0.2, pos:[3.5, 3.1, -0.1], color:C_BLACK}); // R shoulder
        api.box({w:0.1, h:0.3, d:0.05, pos:[3.2, 2.0, 0.35], color:C_BLACK}); // plus v
